faq.question: How can I contact Ikhwan Ramadhan about a Junior Web Developer opportunity?
faq.answer: Contact me directly on WhatsApp at +62 823-8647-3410, by email at ikhwn.rdn@gmail.com, or through the message form on this site. I respond promptly to interview requests and technical discussions.

faq.question: Are you available for on-site work or relocation?
faq.answer: Yes. I am open to on-site positions throughout Indonesia and relocation, as well as hybrid and remote work.

faq.question: What technical skills would you bring to a team?
faq.answer: My focus is software engineering, especially building frontend-to-backend applications with Next.js and TypeScript. I work with user interfaces, REST APIs, databases, Zod validation, testing, security fundamentals, Git workflows, and serverless deployment.
